eld.notes: ELL endorsement, K-12, per 5 CSR 20-400.570 (effective Aug 1, 2017): requires a valid Missouri permanent or professional teaching certificate, recommendation from a DESE-approved educator preparation program (per 5 CSR 20-400.500), 18 semester hours of content coursework (linguistics, language and culture, second language acquisition, methods, curriculum, assessment), 6 hours literacy, 3 hours psychology of the exceptional child, a 3-hour culminating clinical experience working with ELLs in elementary and secondary settings, and a qualifying score on the required exit assessment(s) per 5 CSR 20-400.310 and 5 CSR 20-400.440.

history.title: Baseline coding (Leider, Colombo & Nerlino, 2021)
history.description: Initial coding of the SEA's bilingual, ELD/ESL, and SEI credentials, professional teaching standards, and EL-population data. Captured Oct–Dec 2019 for the EPAA 29(100) document analysis; this row is the as-of-2019 snapshot against which subsequent verifications are diffed.

history.title: Missouri Seal of Biliteracy adopted
history.description: Missouri adopted the Seal of Biliteracy in 2017, administered by DESE. The DESE Seal of Biliteracy program now reports annual results back to 2020-21 across 127+ participating districts and includes a Distinguished Seal of Biliteracy tier.

history.title: 5 CSR 20-400.570 ELL Certification Requirements (K-12) effective
history.description: DESE's ELL endorsement rule (5 CSR 20-400.570) took effect August 1, 2017, codifying the K-12 add-on certification: 18 hours of content coursework (linguistics, language and culture, second-language acquisition, methods, curriculum, assessment), 3 hours psychology of the exceptional child, 6 hours literacy, a 3-hour field/clinical experience, and a qualifying exit assessment. Together with 5 CSR 20-400.500 (general approved-program requirement) and 5 CSR 20-400.310 / .440 (assessments), this rule grounds the schema's `eld.requirements.{program,coursework,practicum,test}: true` codings.

history.title: Missouri's Teacher Standards revised (August 2025)
history.description: DESE issued a revised "Missouri's Teacher Standards" document in August 2025 that replaces the older standards used in the 2019 baseline. The revised standards retain Standard 1.5 ("Diverse social and cultural perspectives"), Standard 2 references to diverse learners, and Standard 6.1's reference to "students whose first language is not Standard English," but do not name English learners explicitly — keeping `professionalStandardsMentions.el: false`.
